_doc: Evaluation suite for the charter-critic (T2.5; case design in the T2.5 row of the build plan). Synthetic, domain-neutral charters for four made-up problems (library returns, volunteer shift swaps, a bike-repair queue, community-hall bookings). Each case gives the owner's answers (the brief as A01, then each answer round) and the charter under review. Rule 8 pairs: S1 (P16/C08) and S2 (P17/C09).
